description: LMS pages: CourseCatalog, CourseDetail, CoursePlayer, PaymentModal — the user-facing LMS surface. Depends on FEAT-001 (types, service, shared components must exist). Independent of FEAT-003 (admin panel). Wires up React Router routes, updates MobileTabBar and App.tsx.
steps: Create src/pages/courses/CourseCatalog.tsx. Default export. Uses useAuth() for currentUser.uid. Uses useQuery from @tanstack/react-query (queryKey: ['courses', filter]) to call getCourses(filter) and useQuery (queryKey: ['enrollments', uid]) to call getUserEnrollments(uid). Layout: MobileTopBar title='Courses' subtitle='Grow your career skills'. Below: featured hero card (if any course has isFeatured===true, render a wide hero card with gold gradient overlay and 'Try Free' / 'Continue' CTA). Filter bar: a row of shadcn Select or Button toggles for Category ('All', 'Career Development') and Level ('All', 'Beginner', 'Intermediate', 'Advanced') and a search Input. Responsive grid: `grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5`. Renders CourseCard for each course, onClick navigates to /courses/:courseId. 'My Learning' section below the grid shows only enrolled/in-progress courses. Loading state: skeleton cards (3 placeholder divs with animate-pulse). Empty state: centered message. pb-safe-tabbar on outer div.

Create src/pages/courses/CourseDetail.tsx. Default export. Reads :courseId from useParams(). useQuery(['course', courseId]) → getCourse(id). useQuery(['enrollment', uid, courseId]) → getUserEnrollments then find. useQuery(['progress', uid, courseId]) → getProgress. Hero: full-width image with dark overlay, title, subtitle, level/duration/lessonsCount badges in gold. Below hero: two-column layout on md+. Left column: description, accordion modules (CourseOutline component). Right column: sticky sidebar card (position: sticky top-20) with price display, ProgressBar if enrolled, and primary CTA button: 'Start Learning' if already enrolled → navigate to /courses/:courseId/learn; 'Enroll Free' if price===0 and not enrolled → calls enrollUserFree then navigate; 'Enroll — RWF X,XXX' if paid → opens PaymentModal; 'Try for Free' if trial available (trialModuleId set) → calls enrollUserFree with trial status placeholder (or enrollUserFree, setting status trial — see lmsService). Also include PaymentModal component below. Load/error states handled.

Create src/components/lms/PaymentModal.tsx. Named export `PaymentModal`. Props: { course: Course, uid: string, open: boolean, onClose: () => void, onSuccess: () => void }. Imports FlutterwavePayment hook/button from 'flutterwave-react-v3'. Uses `import.meta.env.VITE_FLUTTERWAVE_PUBLIC_KEY ?? 'FLWPUBK_TEST-XXXX'` for the public key. Wraps a shadcn Dialog. Inside Dialog: course title, price in RWF, Flutterwave config: { public_key, tx_ref: `lms-${uid}-${course.id}-${Date.now()}`, amount: course.price, currency: course.currency, customer: { email: currentUser.email ?? '', name: currentUser.displayName ?? '' }, customizations: { title: course.title, description: course.subtitle, logo: '/logo.png' } }. On payment callback: if status==='successful' call enrollUserPaid(uid, course.id, data.tx_ref) then toast.success('Enrolled!') then onSuccess(). On close/cancel: toast.error('Payment cancelled'). Uses useAuth() to get currentUser email/displayName. Handles loading state on the pay button.

Create src/pages/courses/CoursePlayer.tsx. Default export. Reads :courseId from useParams(). useQuery(['course', courseId]) + useQuery(['enrollment', uid, courseId]). If not enrolled → redirect to /courses/:courseId. Layout: two-panel on md+, single column on mobile (sidebar collapsed to a top dropdown). Left sidebar (md:w-64 shrink-0): CourseOutline component with currentModule state, onModuleClick updates currentModule. Main area (flex-1): iframe src=`${course.scormUrl}` (for now the whole SCORM URL, not per-module) with sandbox='allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms allow-popups' allow='fullscreen'. postMessage xAPI listener: `window.addEventListener('message', (e) => { if (e.data?.verb === 'completed' || e.data?.percentComplete) updateProgress(uid, courseId, e.data.percentComplete ?? 100, e.data) })`. ProgressBar above iframe showing current percentComplete. MobileTopBar with back=true, title=course.title. On mobile: sidebar is a Sheet (shadcn) triggered by a menu button in the top bar's `right` prop. pb-0 (no tab bar needed in player view — player is full-screen-ish). No MiniChatbot on this page (it is not in APP_ROUTES, so Chrome won't render tab bar — but MiniChatbot still shows; acceptable, player has enough space).

Update src/App.tsx: (a) Add three lazy imports — CourseCatalog = lazy(() => import('./pages/courses/CourseCatalog')), CourseDetail = lazy(() => import('./pages/courses/CourseDetail')), CoursePlayer = lazy(() => import('./pages/courses/CoursePlayer')). (b) Add to TITLE_MAP: '/courses': 'Courses — Student Companion AI', '/courses/:courseId': 'Course — Student Companion AI', '/courses/:courseId/learn': 'Learn — Student Companion AI'. (Note: TITLE_MAP uses prefix matching so /courses prefix covers sub-paths). (c) Add '/courses' to APP_ROUTES array so MobileTabBar shows on catalog page. (d) Add three protected routes: <Route path='/courses' element={<ProtectedRoute><CourseCatalog /></ProtectedRoute>} />, <Route path='/courses/:courseId' element={<ProtectedRoute><CourseDetail /></ProtectedRoute>} />, <Route path='/courses/:courseId/learn' element={<ProtectedRoute><CoursePlayer /></ProtectedRoute>} />.

Update src/components/mobile/MobileTabBar.tsx: Replace the 'Docs' tab entry { to: '/documents', label: 'Docs', icon: FileText } with { to: '/courses', label: 'Courses', icon: GraduationCap }. Add GraduationCap to the lucide-react import. Remove FileText from import if no longer used (it was only in this file). Grid stays grid-cols-5.

Update src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: (a) Add a 'Courses' entry to NAV_LINKS: { id: 'courses', label: 'Courses' }. (b) Add a new section element with ref={setRef('courses')} id='courses' between the PRODUCTS & SERVICES section and the TEAM section. The section shows: heading 'Learn with us', subtitle 'Career-focused courses built for ALU students', a single course preview card (hard-coded seed course preview — image /campus.png, title 'Career Readiness 101', badge 'Free', brief description, and a 'Start Learning →' button that navigates to /signup), and a small note 'Sign in to access full course library'. Style to match the landing page's established pattern (white bg, alu-gold accents, max-w-6xl container, py-24). (c) Add 'courses' to the setActiveSection logic — the useEffect offset loop already handles it via NAV_LINKS iteration.
Add VITE_FLUTTERWAVE_PUBLIC_KEY= to src/.env.example (append at the bottom under a # LMS section comment). Do not write to .env.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build exits 0 with all three course pages and PaymentModal compiling
MobileTabBar shows 'Courses' tab with GraduationCap icon instead of 'Docs'
Navigating to /courses (after login) renders CourseCatalog without runtime errors
Navigating to /courses/career-readiness-101 renders CourseDetail with sidebar CTA
Navigating to /courses/career-readiness-101/learn renders CoursePlayer with iframe pointing to https://share.articulate.com/z08w8cMiDEbwgFjZHJDnC
LandingPage has a Courses section visible in the nav and on the page
PaymentModal renders inside a shadcn Dialog and contains Flutterwave config with fallback key
